pages.text: With $(thing)Create$() installed (and not Create Crafts & Additions, which has its own), Radiocraft adds an $(item)Alternator$(): turn its shaft and it pushes power into the block beside it, such as a $(item)large battery$().$(br2)It makes 360 FE/t at 256 RPM, in proportion: one large water wheel geared to 8 RPM gives about 11 FE/t, enough for a VHF base station.

pages.title: Making one
pages.text: On a $(thing)mechanical crafter$() grid: a shaft in the middle, antenna wire round it, iron sheets round that and andesite alloy at the two ends.$(br2)The $(item)large battery$() takes power from other mods' generators too.
